faqs.a: Orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days. Standard delivery takes 4–7 business days depending on your pincode. Metro cities are usually faster (2–4 days).
Shipping is free on orders above ₹1000. Orders below ₹1000 have a flat ₹50 shipping charge, shown at checkout before you pay.

faqs.q: How do I track my order?
faqs.a: Log in and go to My Orders to see the live status of every order (pending, paid, processing, shipped, delivered). You can also ask me directly — just say 'where is my latest order'.
Most items can be returned within 7 days of delivery if they are unused and in original packaging. Start a return from the order detail page under My Orders.
Once a returned item is received and inspected, refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5–7 business days.
We accept UPI, credit/debit cards, and net banking through Razorpay (secure online payment). Cash on Delivery is available on eligible orders.
Yes. Payments are processed by Razorpay and verified with a server-side signature check. We never store your full card or UPI details on our servers.
You can cancel an order from its detail page as long as it has not yet been shipped. Once cancelled, any reserved stock is released automatically.

faqs.q: My order says unpaid — what do I do?
faqs.a: Open the order from My Orders and use the 'Pay Now' button to retry the payment. Your items stay reserved until you complete or cancel the order.

faqs.q: Do I need an account to shop?
faqs.a: You can browse products and build a cart as a guest, but you must be logged in to place an order and to track it afterwards.

faqs.q: An item I want is out of stock — what now?
faqs.a: Stock counts are live. If an item shows as unavailable it is currently sold out — check back later, as popular items are restocked periodically.

faqs.q: Can I change my shipping address after ordering?
faqs.a: The shipping address is locked once an order is placed. If it has not shipped yet, cancel the order and place it again with the correct address.

faqs.q: How do I get an invoice or receipt?
faqs.a: Each order's detail page shows the full payment summary (items, shipping, total) and the payment ID, which serves as your receipt for the order.

faqs.q: I received a damaged or wrong item.
faqs.a: We're sorry about that. Start a return within 7 days from the order detail page and select the damaged/wrong-item reason so it is prioritised.
For anything I can't resolve here, reach the support team through the Contact page. Have your Order ID ready so they can help faster.

faqs.q: Do you offer discounts or price matching?
faqs.a: Active discounts and offers are applied automatically at checkout when eligible. We don't offer manual price matching against other stores.
